name: oml
description: Remember and recall through an Open Memory Lab server over MCP. Writes are held until a different identity ratifies them.

url.title: OML server URL
url.description: Your Open Memory Lab server, without /mcp. Leave the default to use the maintainer's public server.

api_key.title: Agent key
api_key.description: This agent's own OML key, never an admin key. Stored in the system keychain.

chat_workarea.title: Chat workarea
chat_workarea.description: Your chat workarea's id, as oml chat init prints it. Chat capture needs it; per-turn recall without it reads only the key's default workarea.
